nodes.line: Right. Talk while I do this.

You are the first person to stop all morning. I start at two in the afternoon and for a month the Yennora back lane has had somebody in it who is not waiting for bread. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Take your time. Do not take a week.

Not being dramatic about this. A light on that lane costs Yennora $71 and the landlord has said no twice, so we are doing it ourselves. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Come and find me after, either way.
Alright. I am listening properly this time.

I am told you do odd jobs. The flour for Yennora comes off a truck at two in the afternoon and last Thursdays the truck came and the flour did not. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

I'll be straight with you. The Yennora loading zone has had a car in it at two in the afternoon every morning this week and the driver waits in it, which makes it worse. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. That's it. That's the whole ask.
Say it plain and I will pay you plain.

nodes.line: If you are here about the sign, the sign is wrong.

Nobody else has offered, so. This business was at Fairfield before it was at Yennora, and there is a woman there who still has the original book. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. If anyone asks, you were never here.

nodes.line: You are not from around the corner, are you.

I'll be straight with you. When the last train into North Strathfield is late, 45 people come out at once and I have to have cars there before they do. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. That's it. That's the whole ask.

nodes.line: Half of this suburb has walked past already. Not one stopped.

It has been three weeks. I have stood on this door near North Strathfield for 45 years and since Thursdays somebody has been sending my guests to a different rank. I am aware how that sounds. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

Nobody else has offered, so. The plates working the North Strathfield rank are dispatched from a depot at Concord West, and the man who runs it has never met a driver he liked. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. If anyone asks, you were never here.
Well? I can read your face from here.
